title: Closure Relief Credited where a Micro Market has Stood Shut and Its Kiosk Failed
content:
An approved suspension request standing on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the trailing year brings the call-out charge printed against the market format into a lapsed funding credit as closure relief, once or twice over according to how heavily the kiosk failed over the same year.

## The clause

1. Where the agreement carries an approved suspension request over the twelve months to the day the credit is worked out, and at or above 4 approved kiosk outage requests over those twelve months, the call-out charge printed against the market format is credited twice over as closure relief.
2. Where the agreement carries an approved suspension request over those twelve months, and below 4 approved kiosk outage requests over them, the call-out charge printed against the market format is credited once.
3. Where the agreement carries no approved suspension request over those twelve months, no closure relief is credited.

## The boundary

The material outage count is 4 approved kiosk outage requests over the twelve months to the day the credit is worked out: exactly 4 is at or above it, and 3 is below it. The suspension limb is met by a single approved suspension request standing over those same twelve months.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement carrying one approved suspension request and 6 approved kiosk outage requests over the trailing year, on a format printing a call-out charge of 145.00 USD, is credited 290.00 USD of closure relief. With only 2 approved kiosk outage requests over that year, it is credited 145.00 USD. With no approved suspension request over the year, nothing is credited as closure relief.
